blurb: 3 Nations Brewing offers a variety of craft beers brewed on site, including lagers, IPAs, stouts, and sours. Guests can enjoy beer on tap at their taprooms with food options from permanent kitchens or local partners. The brewery hosts events like trivia, live music, and karaoke, and offers private tours and a Mug Club membership.
extraNote: Beer to go limited to 288 oz. per person per day · Beer-to-go orders may not be consumed on premises · Taproom at 1033 E. Vandergriff Dr., Carrollton, TX
